'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[List of high-altitude object events in 2023|High-altitude object events in 2023]]
**[[2023 Lake Huron high-altitude object]]
***A [[United States Air Force]] [[General Dynamics F-16 Fighting Falcon|F-16 Fighting Falcon]] shoots down an [[unidentified flying object]] over [[Lake Huron]] near the [[Canada–United States border]]. The Department of Defense describe the object as octagonal and flying at roughly 20,000 feet. [https://www.forbes.com/sites/mattnovak/2023/02/12/yet-another-flying-object-shot-down-near-us-canada-border-on-sunday/ (Forbes)]
***[[United States Department of Defense|The Pentagon]] holds a [[press conference|press briefing]] on the shootdowns with [[NORAD]] [[Commander of NORAD|Commander]] [[Glen D. VanHerck]] stating it is currently unclear how the objects were "staying aloft", and "we're calling them objects, not balloons, for a reason". [https://eng.bharattimes.co.in/us-brings-down-another-flying-object-fourth-such-shootdown-in-9-days/ (Bharat Times)]
**[[2023 Shandong high-altitude object]]
***[[China]] says that it has detected an unidentified flying object over the [[Yellow Sea]], and warns that it is prepared to shoot down the object. The Qingdao Marine Development Bureau issues an alert to fishermen in the waters to be "on alert" and "avoid risks". [https://www.scmp.com/news/china/diplomacy/article/3209964/china-spots-mystery-object-over-waters-near-northern-port-city (''South China Morning Post'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2022–23 South Pacific cyclone season]]
**Thousands of people are left [[Power outage|without power]] as [[Cyclone Gabrielle]] makes landfall over [[North Island]], [[New Zealand]]. The regions of [[Northland Region|Northland]] and [[Auckland Region|Auckland]] are currently under a [[state of emergency]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-64617013 (BBC News)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Censorship in Cambodia]]
**[[Prime Minister of Cambodia|Cambodian prime minister]] [[Hun Sen]] orders the closure of one of the country's last independent news outlets, The Voice of Democracy, saying that its publications have hurt him and his son [[Hun Manet]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/cambodias-hun-sen-orders-shutdown-last-independent-local-news-outlet-2023-02-12/ (Reuters)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2023 Cypriot presidential election]]
**In a run-off election, [[Nikos Christodoulides]] is  [[2023 Cypriot presidential election|elected]] as [[President of Cyprus]], defeating [[Andreas Mavroyiannis]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/cypriot-diplomats-face-off-cliffhanger-presidential-vote-2023-02-12/ (Reuters)]
*[[NATO secretary general]] [[Jens Stoltenberg]] announces that he will not extend his mandate to serve a fourth term and is expected to step down in October. [https://www.scmp.com/news/world/europe/article/3209959/nato-chief-stoltenberg-plans-leave-office-october (AFP via ''South China Morning Post'')]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[Asteroid impact prediction]]
**Researchers at the [[Konkoly Observatory]] in [[Hungary]] discover {{mpl|2023 CX|1}}, a {{convert|1|m|ft|abbr=off|adj=on}} asteroid predicted to fall harmlessly as a [[Meteoroid#Fireball|fireball]] over the [[English Channel]] at 03:00 UTC, making it the seventh asteroid to be discovered before impacting Earth. [https://cneos.jpl.nasa.gov/scout/#/object/Sar2667 (JPL Center for NEO Studies)] <!--The most reliable, but not the most direct source. Note "impact rating" in the top rated at 4 - the highest level - meaning "almost certain impact"-->

'''Sports'''
*[[2022 NFL season]]
**The [[Kansas City Chiefs]] defeat the [[Philadelphia Eagles]] 38–35 in [[Super Bowl LVII]], winning their third [[Super Bowl]] in franchise history. [https://www.cnbc.com/amp/2023/02/12/super-bowl-2023-ads-live-coverage.html (CNBC)]
*[[2023 Turkey–Syria earthquake]]
**[[2022–23 Süper Lig]]
***[[Gaziantep F.K.|Gaziantep]] becomes the 2nd club (after [[Hatayspor]]) to withdraw from the [[Süper Lig|top division]] of Turkish football due to the [[2023 Turkey–Syria earthquake|earthquake]]. [https://www.tff.org/default.aspx?pageID=687&ftxtID=39572 (Turkish Football Federation)]
